order: This pass fixes every finding from the prior round. It starts by replacing the copied-over runner semantics in the research seat's brief with the tool's real behavior, meaning a live working tree, no sandbox pinning, and no automatic retries, so each order gets just one call while unavailability escalates to the coordinating role instead of retrying silently. The write-capable runner then gets reconciled with the read-only plan across three briefs, so every order carries that same restriction in its own text and also passes the forbid parameter, described accurately as a brief-level prohibition rather than a sandboxed block. The earlier incident narrative gets rewritten into its evidence-supported account, and the unsupported claim gets withdrawn entirely rather than merely softened. Two exercise reports whose dispatch-time details were dropped or wrong get fixed as well. The minor findings get cleared too, including stale status rows, a wrong tool count, and an unjustified omission.
claims: All four major findings and every follow-on minor issue were resolved, spanning exactly ten files and adding 169 lines while removing forty-six. The work covers the runner-semantics rewrite and the read-only reconciliation across three briefs, along with the incident-narrative rewrite and two fixed exercise reports. The tool count was fixed to the actual four registered tools, and that count was confirmed by checking each brief against the tool registry directly. Each change was then verified line by line against the source file it corrects, so nothing was left unchecked.
